claim().details: Enforces the validation, accounting, and state-transition rules required by claim. Additional validation, accounting, and bounded-execution rules apply. Additional validation, accounting, and bounded-execution rules apply. Call path: user or MobV2Gateway.claimNodeRewards -> NodeRewardPool.claim -> NodeRewardPool._settle/_refreshDebt -> InteractionPool.pay(MÖB/USDT,user,).

configureEarningsSettlement(address).details: Call path: Deploy._configure -> NodeRewardPool.configureEarningsSettlement; then MiningSystem.withdraw/consumeComposition -> MiningEarningsSettlement -> NodeRewardPool.recordNetworkReward.

configureTradingRouter(address).details: Call path: Deploy._configure -> NodeRewardPool.configureTradingRouter; then TradingRouter.sellMob -> NodeRewardPool.recordSaleFeeReward.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC-1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

recordNetworkReward(address,uint256).details: Call path: user -> MiningSystem.withdraw/composeCard -> MiningEarningsSettlement -> NodeRewardPool.recordNetworkReward; , .

setNetworkRewardBps(uint8,uint256).details: Call path: operator -> NodeRewardPool.setNetworkRewardBps; then MiningSystem.withdraw/compose -> MiningEarningsSettlement -> NodeRewardPool.recordNetworkReward .

setOperator(address).details: Call path: ownerDeploy._configure -> NodeRewardPool.setOperator; then operator -> NodeRewardPool.setNetworkRewardBps./.

stake(uint256).details: Call path: user -> NodeRewardPool.stake -> NodeRewardPool._settle -> NodeCard.safeTransferFrom -> NodeRewardPool.onERC721Received; PRD.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.
